I've reviewed the comp anchors and comparable IC/manager benchmarks in the SF metro (attached comp_anchor_q2_2027.xlsx). Short version:
- L5 Senior IC anchor (median): $200k base / 0.35% eq / target OTE ~ $240k
- L6 Manager anchor (median): $220k base / 0.45% eq / target OTE ~ $275k
